# Outcome

- Intended outcome: Outcome A - No-overlap numbers are allowed but flagged. Today the scenario editor (src/app/(user)/scenario/[id]/edit/EditScenarioClient.tsx) disables Save whenever any Issue's zone check in src/components/scenarios/IssueNumbersEditor.tsx (issueZone) is not ok. That includes limits that simply do not overlap ("No overlap: no deal is possible with these limits"). The API already accepts non-overlapping limits: the scenario codec only rejects targets on the wrong side of their walk-aways. Change the editor so that non-overlapping walk-aways are a warning, not a blocker: the Issue still shows a warning that says no deal is possible, Save stays enabled, saving succeeds, and after a reload the saved numbers and the warning are still shown. Targets on the wrong side of the walk-aways must keep blocking Save exactly as today (e2e/playwright/acceptance/slice-13.spec.ts relies on it).
